fusions.name: Hewing Tail
fusions.desc: Swings your tail through a cone 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Falling Wedge
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. You drop onto it scale-edge first, dealing 24 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 4 seconds and 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Baited Edge
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds and increases your critical damage by 35% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Fresh Edge
fusions.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises by 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
